title: Our Families' Jobs
text:
My name is Ana. I am a doctor. I work at a big hospital in the city. Every day, I help sick people. I like my job very much.

My brother is a teacher. He works at a school for children. He teaches math and science. He starts work at eight o'clock in the morning. His students are happy with him.

questions.text: What can we infer about how Ana feels about her job?
options: She feels good about helping people
She does not like her work
She wants to become a teacher

questions.text: What can we infer about the brother's students?

vocabulary.definition: a person who helps sick people
a place where sick people get help

paragraph_translations: Me llamo Ana. Soy médica. Trabajo en un hospital grande de la ciudad. Todos los días ayudo a las personas enfermas. Me gusta mucho mi trabajo.
Mi hermano es maestro. Trabaja en una escuela para niños. Enseña matemáticas y ciencias. Empieza a trabajar a las ocho de la mañana. Sus estudiantes están contentos con él.
